evidence: node driver.mjs and its headless Chrome have shown no output for 15 minutes
the tree uses almost no CPU and writes only IPC bytes
result.diagnosis: The driver waits on an idle headless Chrome and will not return the call.
result.mechanism: node driver.mjs waits on a headless Chrome that never answers, so the bash call holding it never returns
result.avoid: Run the driver with an explicit timeout and close Chrome when the script ends
